title: R2 finite operator-allomorph selection for complete typed mixture accounts
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Prospective source-only writing rival defined before any R1 target outcome: keep S0 and exact R1 atomic packing/holes, but select a shared operator allomorph by the same fixed entry and absorbed-MIXED contexts instead of universal ENTRY/AGREE pieces. Exact family: 39 operator allomorphs plus 18 shared payload components, one prefix-free code. Four complete source/generated accounts and a different literal-writing consequence are supplied; no target fit.

design.mechanism: Every R1 core keeps all payload components in order; the head alone is replaced by its deterministic (head,entry,mixed) allomorph. Remove universal entry/agreement components. Recursively emit every owned HOLE child in argument order. Same S0 semantics and limits, no additional states, glosses or exceptions.
design.unit: One complete variable-size S0 account with every header, branch, statement, assertion, argument and terminal yield. Group boundaries follow exact R1 packing, not source or target token counts.
design.contrast: R1 forces at most two literal group-initial characters and at least three characters in every group. R2 does not: a complete global prefix-free code witness has four header/marker initials and a one-character FIRST. R2 additionally forces identical encoded operand tails for FINE(RREF1) and YIELD(RREF1); R1 adds different result-class suffixes. Both retain different SETR allomorphs at branch entry versus after a used declaration. Not claimed to be disjoint or nested full languages.
design.prediction: The same operator/context always has one shared code independent of argument values; every numerical digit/material/reference/HOLE component is globally unchanged across operators and contexts. All typed arities, hole ownership, reference limits and arithmetic checks remain. A syntactically legal program is insufficient: every written assertion and declared goal must be true. No independent target content binding or bounded target test is claimed.

semantic_model.name: S0 unchanged

productions.Q: NUM(n) | MIXED(NUM(w),NUM(p),NUM(d)) | QREF(i) | ADD(Q,Q) | SUB(Q,Q) | MUL(Q,Q) | DIV(Q,Q) | MASS(R) | FINE(R) | GRADE(R)

semantic_model.material_policy: Immutable recipe vectors. Repeating a recipe reference reuses a definition, not physical stock. Different alternatives may have different vectors and histories while sharing mass/fine goals. No requirement that a second branch by itself identify any meanings.

writing_family.atom_spelling: TYPE emits its type atom; NUM and references emit their shared prefix followed by shared digit atoms. MIXED emits MIXED plus all three complete NUM component spellings. No whole rational is assigned a new independent value.
writing_family.core_production: head(C) slot(a1)...slot(ak); atomic slot emits its complete atom spelling; non-atomic slot emits HOLE. SETQ/SETR indices are shared decimal digits in the head. Emit non-atomic child cores recursively in original argument order.
writing_family.header: GRADES(A,NUM(a),B,NUM(b),C,NUM(c)), TARGET(NUM(t)), TOTAL(NUM(m)), then FIRST/ALTERNATIVELY and all branch statements.
writing_family.whole_group: H(head@entry,mixed) followed by H of each unchanged core payload atom; no ENTRY or AGREE component. Labels such as SETR@10 encode entry=1,mixed=0.
writing_family.entry_function: entry=0 iff first account group or first group after FIRST/ALTERNATIVELY; otherwise entry=1. No line or leaf state.
writing_family.mixed_function: mixed=1 iff the core directly absorbs a literal MIXED atomic argument; otherwise zero. No inspection of deferred/referenced numerical values.
writing_family.result_class: Determined by the operator and used only by unchanged typing; no separately realized class marker.
writing_family.spacing: A physical line break may replace a group-separating space while remaining recorded, with no semantic/context reset. No internal spaces, arbitrary erasure, comments or other whitespace changes.
writing_family.finite_limit_policy: Retains S0 bounds and R0/R1 alphabet/codeword bounds. Only 39 statically licensed head/context cells exist. No cell, context, state, word key or silent filler may be added after data inspection. Ten more global code entries than R1, nineteen more than R0; capacity unassessed.
writing_family.whole_form_limit: Operator-specific selection and the original fixed entry/direct-MIXED conditions are one bounded compositional hypothesis. They do not explain all known whole-form residuals by assertion.
